sim.long-description: Rough Arrow III for MGA's commercial and CFI stages: the PA28 Archer airframe and cockpit with retractable gear (keys g and G, or the gear lever), a 200 hp fuel-injected Lycoming IO-360-C1C6 and a constant-speed prop (prop lever on the quadrant, 2000 to 2700 rpm). The gear can't come up with weight on the wheels. Flight model tuned to about 137 KTAS at 75% power gear up and 830 fpm climb at gross.
